sentences.text: If you press a block onto a spinning tire, you have a brake.
But the rubber grinds and smoke pours off.
So you bolt on a steel disc and squeeze that.
But your hand is weak, and the disc keeps spinning at 60.
So you add a pedal, a pipe and fluid that multiplies your push four to five times.
Push the pedal, the pads clamp, and the wheel stops.
But now hard stops heat the disc until it glows red.
So you cut vents, and air cools the disc.
Repeated hard stops can heat a disc past 500 degrees Celsius.
Add a brake light that glows when you press the pedal.
Congratulations, you have built a disc brake.
